consumer.hypotheses: S:Finset(Fin8→Real); hS:every member in Submodule.E8 Real; ε:NNReal (zero allowed); strict2*(ε:Real)<sqrt2. Empty S allowed. The center-set corollary additionally assumes C:Set(EuclideanSpace Real(Fin8)) and Metric.IsCover ε of the exact toLp image; C may be infinite and need not lie in E8/sample. No other hypotheses or type universes.
consumer.conclusion: The exact finite Euclidean sample requires one closed-ball external cover center per point whenever 2ε<sqrt2. Every proposed cover, including one with arbitrary nonlattice centers, has ENat cardinal at least S.card. The sample itself supplies a cover attaining equality. This turns the existing E8 separation into a covering-cost statement rather than re-exporting pairwise separation.
consumer.use: Turn actual Euclidean E8 sample separation into exact external covering cost and an ENat cardinal lower bound for every proposed cover, using the existing Metric covering-number API.
